name: hybrid_a
description: Region bisection, half A. Carries the +60 save with the FIRST five differing regions (0x00203-0x00C8E) replaced by the corresponding bytes from the offset-0 save. Same squad shrink as the other probes so one short fight decides. If this reads 25 the cause lives in those regions; if 85 it lives in the other five, which hybrid_b carries.
